prompts.task: Instrument the FastAPI and Celery service in ./service with OpenTelemetry while preserving the existing Docker Compose runtime. Add auto-instrumentation only. The API startup must use a separate explicit OTel setup module; the Celery worker must invoke that setup and Celery instrumentation from worker_process_init so worker.py import stays provider-free. Makefile-, Dockerfile-, Compose-, entrypoint-, or CLI-wrapper-only instrumentation is insufficient.

checks.description: Docker runtime emits FastAPI traces to a running Observer.
